verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents version tracking that shows which code versions throw exceptions (rollbar-docs-6), plus deploy tracking that 'unlocks several features' for debugging (rollbar-docs-7, rollbar-docs-28). 'Deploy and version tracking' is listed as a plan feature (rollbar-docs-40). That covers the release-association core, but nothing in the pack shows commit association or suspect-commit attribution. missing for 10: evidence that each item shows the release it first appeared in, commit association and suspect-commit identification, details of what deploy tracking actually unlocks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
